text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you have about two hours to 
spare sometime soon? Tomorrow—no, today 
would be best.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I want to go to an esthetic clinic. Maybe 
it's the intense sun, but the skin around 
my eyes feels dry.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
In a state like this, even the tiara I've 
rightfully earned would be ruined.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: What do you mean, 'is it alright'?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It might not seem obvious at first glance, 
but to her, it was a grave situation. To 
help cheer her up, I opened my planner...
